content:
Create a whimsical hand-drawn watercolor travel poster triptych on a white paper background, divided into exactly 3 equal vertical panels by thin black lines, with a dark charcoal footer strip across the bottom. Each panel shows a miniature floating island cityscape with tiny landmarks, soft shadows, dotted airplane flight paths, small doodle clouds and birds, and a blue watercolor patch of water with a small boat. Use delicate ink outlines, pastel colors, architectural detail, and a clean sketchbook style.

Panel 1: {argument name="first destination label" default="London"} with a tiny red heart after the label. Include exactly 6 main visible London elements: a red telephone booth, the London Eye, Big Ben and Parliament, Tower Bridge towers, a red double-decker bus, and a small white river boat on blue water below.

Panel 2: {argument name="second destination label" default="China"} with a tiny red heart after the label. Include exactly 7 main visible China elements: a traditional pagoda, a pink cherry blossom tree, a small panda, a green Great Wall section on hills, a red-and-gold Chinese palace gate, the Oriental Pearl Tower, and a Shanghai-style skyscraper, plus a small wooden boat on the water below.

Panel 3: {argument name="third destination label" default="United States"} with a tiny red heart after the label. Include exactly 9 main visible United States elements: a leafy tree, a vintage street lamp with an “NY” sign, the Golden Gate Bridge, a yellow taxi, the Statue of Liberty, a grey skyscraper cluster, the Chrysler Building, a waving American flag, and a retro diner sign reading “DINER”, plus a small white sailboat on blue water below.

Add exactly 3 dotted airplane paths total, one above each panel, each ending in a tiny airplane flying up to the right. Add small simple clouds and bird silhouettes in the empty sky areas. Destination names should be centered under each miniature scene in a neat handwritten font. The bottom footer strip should contain italic light-gray text reading: “Source: Naiknelofar788 on X”. Keep the overall composition horizontal, charming, airy, and highly detailed, with no extra countries, no extra panels, and no photorealism.

Goal: Create an ornate dark-fantasy anime event announcement poster for {argument name="event title" default="覚醒の光"}, with the English subtitle “Light of Awakening,” themed around transforming the same original character through a more fitting magical light.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, richly detailed, midnight navy and gold color palette, glowing celestial atmosphere, elegant fantasy UI framing, high-resolution anime illustration style.

Layout: Divide the poster into three main zones. Top zone: exactly 3 tall arched stained-glass character panels arranged left, center, right. Middle zone: large title typography and mascot. Bottom zone: participation flow and event date information.

Top character panels: Show the same elegant anime girl in all 3 panels, preserving her pose, outfit, hairstyle, and overall identity while changing the lighting mood in each panel. She has long pale silver-blue hair, a dark bow or floral hair ornament, blue eyes, a black-and-white gothic fantasy dress with layered frills, translucent teal-black overskirt, gold chains and star ornaments, thigh-high white stockings, ornate black boots, small feathered wings, and an open book held in one hand. Count exactly 3 versions: left panel with divine pale sunlight streaming through a circular stained-glass halo; center panel with bright blue celestial awakening light, crystalline reflections, strongest glow, and elaborate gold frame; right panel with purple-blue moonlit stained glass and mystical shimmer. Each panel should have an ornate gold arch frame with star motifs and delicate filigree.

Middle zone: Place a cute chibi elf mascot at lower left of the title area. The mascot is a blonde female elf with long wavy hair, green eyes, pointed ears, cheerful open-mouth smile, dark adventurer outfit with gold accents, small boots, and explorer accessories. She holds a magnifying glass in one hand and a parchment/map in the other. To her right, place the huge glowing Japanese title {argument name="main Japanese title" default="覚醒の光"} in luminous white-gold serif calligraphy, with small sparkle symbols around it. Under it, place the English subtitle “Light of Awakening.” Below that, place the Japanese tagline {argument name="tagline" default="光が変われば、物語も変わる。"} in glowing pale blue-white. Beneath the tagline, add a small gold-framed ribbon reading “同じプロンプト、違う雰囲気”.

Bottom flow section: Create exactly 3 rectangular framed cards in a row with arrows between them. Card 1 label: “元画像”; image: a small square portrait of a brown-haired gothic lolita anime girl with red roses in her hair. Card 2 label: “プロンプト”; image: a glowing white feather over a starry blue background. Card 3 label: “生成”; image: the same brown-haired girl transformed by warmer dramatic light. Add two gold arrows, one between card 1 and card 2, and one between card 2 and card 3. At the bottom left, show the hashtag {argument name="hashtag" default="#覚醒の光"}. At the bottom center, show the event period {argument name="event period" default="8/13 18:00 – 8/16 23:59 JST"} in large gold-white serif text. On the lower right, add a small ornate plaque reading “GPT / Grok / Meta AI でテスト済み”.

Decorative elements: Count exactly these major decorative props: 3 large arched stained-glass frames at the top, 3 bottom instruction cards, 1 chibi elf mascot, 1 compass at lower right, 1 lantern near the right edge, 3 rolled parchment scrolls on the right side and lower right, multiple gold chains draped across the top and corners, starbursts, tiny constellations, crystal ornaments, and antique map fragments. Use lavish gold filigree borders around the entire poster.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed fantasy anime key visual, luminous magical lighting, polished gacha-game event banner aesthetic, ornate art nouveau frames, stained glass, celestial sparkles, deep shadows, radiant highlights, high contrast, elegant Japanese typography, premium poster design.

Constraints: Keep all text crisp and readable. Preserve the exact count of the 3 top character panels and 3 bottom flow cards. Do not add extra characters beyond the main repeated girl and the single chibi elf mascot. Avoid modern UI minimalism; the design should feel antique, magical, and ceremonial.

Create a cinematic widescreen fantasy historical scene in a realistic film-still style. A lone {argument name="hero type" default="ancient Greek warrior"} stands centered with his back to the viewer on a sunlit stone terrace, wearing bronze-and-leather armor, a short skirt of armor strips, dark boots, bracers, and a weathered beige cloak draped over one shoulder and trailing in the wind. He holds a lowered sword in his right hand while staring across a calm turquoise sea toward distant rocky islands. In the sky to the upper right, show exactly 1 flying dragon: a small grey wyvern-like creature with outstretched wings, long tail, and open talons, silhouetted against pale clouds. On the left side, include an ancient temple facade with exactly 3 tall fluted stone columns, a dark doorway, worn steps, cracked marble blocks, and Mediterranean greenery. Include exactly 3 visible ceramic vessels: 1 large bronze urn near the temple steps on the left, 1 small potted tree in a terracotta pot near the terrace edge, and 1 large terracotta jar on the lower right. The setting is a coastal ancient ruin with cracked stone paving, low walls, shrubs, mountains on the horizon, and soft late-afternoon light. Use muted natural colors, subtle film grain, high detail, realistic textures, epic mythological atmosphere, 16:9 aspect ratio, no text, no modern objects, no extra people.

Create a vertical romantic impressionist oil painting of a young couple seen from behind, holding hands and walking away through a lush flower meadow in the rain toward a warm glowing sunset. The man wears a light blue rolled-sleeve shirt and dark pants; the woman wears a flowing teal sleeveless dress, with long dark hair blown to the side by the wind. Above them, paint one large vivid rainbow arcing diagonally from the upper left toward the upper right, with clear red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and violet bands. The scene should feel magical, hopeful, and alive, with sunlight breaking through stormy gray-blue clouds behind the couple. Use thick impasto palette-knife texture, visible ridges of paint, expressive brushstrokes, and saturated colors. Add many elongated white and pale-blue raindrops streaking vertically across the entire canvas, including large glossy drops in the foreground. Fill the bottom half with dense green foliage and yellow, cream, and orange wildflowers painted in chunky strokes. Keep the composition centered on the two figures, backlit by golden light, with the rainbow framing them overhead. No text, no border, no watermark.

Goal: Create a dark, gritty found-footage surveillance still from a horror game, styled like a Garry's Mod / Source engine machinima interrogation scene.

Canvas: 16:9 widescreen frame, low-resolution CCTV/VHS look, heavy film grain, scanline noise, slight fisheye distortion, black vignette around the edges, desaturated gray-green color grading.

Scene: A small police interrogation room viewed from a high corner security camera. The room has grimy concrete walls, a dark tiled floor, black baseboards, and harsh dim overhead lighting. In the center is one rectangular metal interrogation table with four thin legs. Exactly 2 seated people are present: 1 detective sitting with his back partly to the camera in a light shirt, and 1 suspect/witness sitting across from him in darker clothing. On the table are exactly 2 visible objects: a small cardboard evidence box and a compact old camcorder or tape device. The mood is tense, ominous, and procedural.

Background elements: On the left wall, include exactly 1 cork bulletin board covered with papers and notices, including a visible poster area suggesting jail rules. On the back wall, include exactly 1 large one-way observation window showing a dark adjacent room with vague desks and monitors. On the right wall, include exactly 1 gray metal door with a narrow vertical rectangular window.

Surveillance overlay: Add white analog camera HUD text and artifacts. Top left reads "CAM 04 - INTERROGATION ROOM". Top right reads "REC" with a small red recording dot. Near the upper left-center reads "00:01:22". Near the upper right-center reads "33%". Bottom right shows two stacked timecode-style readings: "02:11:96" above "9:42". Bottom left has a faint white "Axon"-style logo. Add a thin damaged tracking line near the top edge and subtle horizontal noise throughout.

Subtitle text: At the bottom center, show yellow monospaced subtitles in exactly 4 lines, reading: "Detective: We found this on an old camcorder." / "The camera belonged to a group of teenagers." / "16-20 years old. Just regular kids, looking for" / "adventure in the abandoned Building ‘B’." Use blocky VHS subtitle styling and keep the text legible.

Customizable details: The camera label may be {argument name="camera label" default="CAM 04 - INTERROGATION ROOM"}; the speaker may be {argument name="speaker name" default="Detective"}; the location mentioned may be {argument name="abandoned location" default="Building ‘B’"}; the recording time may be {argument name="recording time" default="00:01:22"}; the battery percentage may be {argument name="battery percentage" default="33%"}.

Constraints: Keep the composition from an elevated security-camera angle, maintain the horror VHS aesthetic, do not add extra people, do not add modern clean UI elements, and keep all overlay text exactly in the style of degraded analog surveillance footage.

Create an abstract topographic mixed-media artwork on a horizontal {argument name="aspect ratio" default="4:3 landscape"} canvas, resembling a large aerial geological map or energetic convergence diagram. The composition centers on a bright glowing circular hub slightly below the middle, made of concentric translucent rings in warm gold, cream, and gray, with thin radial lines extending outward. From this center, four broad organic terrain-like regions flow outward: a dark charcoal and slate-black river-shaped mass sweeping from the left edge into the center and down toward the lower left, a rusty burnt-orange and sienna canyon-like band expanding from the center to the lower right, a pale cream and sand-colored open field filling the upper and right areas, and muted gray-beige layered landforms in the upper left and lower middle. Cover the image with delicate contour lines, hairline curves, dotted paths, small node circles, and fine white and black route-like lines that weave across the colored regions. Include exactly 3 small orange dots near the upper center, exactly 2 large ochre circular stains in the upper right, and numerous tiny scattered black, white, gray, and gold dots arranged like constellations and map markers. Use a restrained palette of {argument name="main palette" default="ivory, charcoal black, warm gray, ochre gold, burnt orange, rust brown"}, with watercolor washes, mineral textures, translucent paper layers, ink scratches, stippling, and subtle grain. The style should feel like an elegant abstract cartographic painting, a cosmic topography, or a geological energy map, with no readable text, no labels, no border, no people, and no recognizable objects. Lighting should be soft and diffuse, with the central hub as the brightest point, creating a sense of motion and convergence. Render highly detailed fine linework and tactile handmade textures, suitable for a gallery-quality generative art print.

Create a highly detailed side-view concept art illustration of a futuristic {argument name="weapon type" default="electromagnetic cannon"} floating horizontally against a plain vivid {argument name="background color" default="green chroma key background"}. The cannon should be long and symmetrical, built from dense exposed sci-fi machinery: layered red armor plates, glossy black structural rails, gold/brass rings and brackets, blue glowing coils, cables, pistons, bolts, vents, and small cylindrical modules. Show exactly 3 major sections: a large circular rear power core on the left with red fin-like petals and a bright blue-white energy glow, a long central barrel assembly with 7 prominent golden electromagnetic coil rings surrounding a bright blue plasma beam running through the middle, and a circular front muzzle on the right with red segmented fins, black radial supports, and a blue glowing aperture. Add exactly 2 small landing/support struts beneath the body, one near the rear-left and one near the lower center-right. Use a crisp polished digital painting style with high contrast, clean outlines, comic/anime mecha detailing, metallic reflections, saturated red-gold-blue palette, and no text, people, watermark, smoke, scenery, or shadows beyond subtle object shading. The object should fill most of a 3:2 landscape canvas, centered with generous green empty space around it.

Goal: Create a realistic screenshot of a minimalist AI chat interface showing a Japanese conversation where a user asks for a 16-bit pixel-art conversion and the assistant responds with a generated image.

Canvas: Portrait screenshot, 768 x 896 px, white background, clean web-app UI with lots of empty space. No browser chrome, no visible sidebars. Use soft gray dividers, rounded cards, and small interface icons.

Layout: Top-right user area contains exactly 2 discrete elements: 1 small square anime avatar, and 1 rounded white chat bubble. The avatar is an anime horse-girl face with brown hair, white forelock, purple eyes, horse ears, and a purple ribbon. The user bubble text is {argument name="user request" default="16bitのピクセルアートにしてください"}.

Assistant message block 1: Place the Manus logo and the bold name “manus” on the left. Below it, show exactly 1 small rounded notice pill containing a sparkle icon and Japanese text {argument name="notice text" default="今回は Manus が負担します—クレジットは消費されません"}. Then show the assistant reply line: {argument name="first assistant reply" default="承知しました。元の表情と配色を保ちながら、16bit風のピクセルアートに仕上げます。"}. Under that, show exactly 2 checked task rows with gray circular check icons: 1) “編集要件を整理する” and 2) “16bit風ピクセルアートを生成する”. Beneath the tasks, show exactly 2 small action icons: a copy icon and a curved-arrow/regenerate-style icon.

Assistant message block 2: Lower on the page, repeat the Manus logo and bold name “manus”. Under it, show a single Japanese sentence: {argument name="second assistant reply" default="16bitゲーム機時代をイメージした、くっきりしたドット絵調に変換しました。"}. Below this sentence, align a large generated image preview to the left.

Generated image preview: The preview is a square-ish pixel-art portrait cropped by the screenshot bottom edge. It shows a cheerful anime horse-girl character in crisp 16-bit game style: brown bob-length hair with a large white forelock, tall horse ears, a purple bow on the left ear, purple sparkling eyes, small blush marks, open smiling mouth, and white hair ties near both sides. Use chunky pixel edges, visible dithering, limited retro palette, and dark outline pixels. Background inside the pixel-art image is a warm indoor room with beige wall, window light, and horizontal furniture/trim, all rendered in pixel art. The visible generated preview should occupy the lower-left portion and be cut off at the bottom of the screenshot.

Additional UI details: Add a small floating circular down-arrow button at the bottom-right corner. Keep the overall look like a Japanese Manus chat page, with generous margins, black body text, subtle gray UI accents, and no true transparency checkerboard. Count of visible repeated UI/content elements: 1 user avatar, 1 user message bubble, 2 Manus headers, 1 notice pill, 2 checked task rows, 2 small action icons, 1 generated image preview, and 1 floating down-arrow button.

Constraints: Preserve the Japanese text exactly where given in the default parameter values. Do not add extra messages, extra avatars, extra buttons, watermarks, browser tabs, or side navigation.

Create a photorealistic vertical portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Anri"}, an elegant young Japanese woman relaxing during a quiet afternoon picnic beside a calm lake. She is seated barefoot on lush green grass in the left foreground with her legs extended diagonally toward the lower right, holding a white bowl filled with green grapes in both hands on her lap. She has soft shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair tied partly back with a large white lace ribbon bow, natural makeup, small earrings, and a gentle peaceful expression while gazing off to the left rather than at the camera. Her outfit is a summery {argument name="dress color" default="white"} sleeveless camisole dress with thin straps, delicate lace trim at the neckline, ribbed bodice texture, and a light airy skirt. The setting is a shaded lakeside park with dappled sunlight filtering through dense green trees overhead, a sparkling lake occupying the right background, and a forested far shore under a pale blue sky. Include exactly 8 distinct picnic props on a pale blanket with red stripe accents behind her: 1 woven wicker picnic basket with handles, 1 small bouquet of pink and white flowers, 1 round tray or shallow basket with bananas and red fruit, 1 small bottle, 1 orange fruit, 1 slender glass vase or cup, 1 folded patterned cushion or cloth roll, and 1 second folded patterned cushion or cloth roll. Use natural warm daylight, soft skin tones, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric and grass detail, subtle lens bokeh in the trees and water, relaxed wholesome mood, high-resolution lifestyle photography composition, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

Create a realistic vertical concert photo of a {argument name="performer type" default="Japanese underground idol who looks like an office worker"} performing on a small dark live-house stage. The singer is a young adult Japanese woman leaning forward toward the audience, smiling warmly while singing into a black handheld microphone held in her right hand, with her left hand pressed over her chest. She has dark brown hair tied back with loose bangs and face-framing strands, natural idol makeup, and an expressive approachable face. Outfit: a fitted black business blazer, open-collar white dress shirt with a slightly glamorous stage look, tight black mini skirt, sheer black pantyhose, black high heels, and a blue lanyard with a visible corporate-style ID badge hanging at her waist. The scene is shot from a low audience perspective, full body visible, with shallow depth of field; include exactly two foreground audience elements: one blurred pair of raised clapping hands with a yellow wristband at lower left, and one blurred back-of-head silhouette at lower right. Background: black curtains, exposed ceiling pipes and rigging, small venue speakers, and colored stage lights, including one red light on the left, one blue light near center-right, and one bright warm white light on the right. Lighting should feel like a candid live performance: dramatic club stage illumination, glossy highlights on hair and clothing, realistic skin tones, slight motion energy but sharp focus on the singer. Composition: vertical 3:4 portrait crop, performer centered and leaning diagonally forward, energetic intimate idol-show atmosphere, photorealistic DSLR quality, no readable brand logos, no added captions or watermarks.

Create a bright, candid photorealistic summer beach portrait of a smiling {argument name="subject" default="young adult Japanese woman"} leaning slightly forward toward the camera under a clear blue sky. She has {argument name="hair style" default="short tousled dark bob hair with windblown strands across her forehead"}, warm natural makeup, and a joyful open smile. She wears a simple {argument name="top" default="white spaghetti-strap camisole"} and a high-waisted {argument name="skirt" default="pale blue flowing floral skirt"} that billows dramatically in the sea breeze. Her hands gather the skirt modestly at the front while the fabric lifts and ripples around her, creating a dynamic sense of motion. Place her on a sandy beach with soft ocean waves and a low horizon in the background, photographed from a slightly low, close perspective with a vertical 3:4 composition. Use natural midday sunlight, soft skin tones, gentle highlights, airy pastel colors, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, subtle film grain, and the look of a nostalgic Japanese summer magazine photoshoot shot on 35mm film. Keep the image wholesome, breezy, sunlit, and free of text or watermarks.

Create a photorealistic vertical lifestyle portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Anri"}, an elegant adult woman relaxing at night in a modern apartment living room. She is seated cross-legged on a beige sofa, facing slightly toward the camera, with an open silver laptop on her lap showing a dark Apple-style logo on the back. She holds a cream-colored coffee cup in her left hand near shoulder height and looks calmly at the viewer with a soft, confident expression. She has short wavy {argument name="hair color" default="ash brown"} bob hair, black rectangular eyeglasses, smooth makeup with red lipstick, and a warm natural complexion. Her outfit is a fitted ribbed beige long-sleeve knit lounge dress with a scalloped low neckline and a small white clip detail on one shoulder; keep the styling tasteful, cozy, and adult. The room is warmly lit by one tall floor lamp glowing on the right, with a large dark window behind her showing blurred city bokeh lights at night. Include a beige cushion on the sofa and a wooden coffee table in the foreground with two small blurred items near the lower left edge. Use shallow depth of field, soft cinematic lighting, realistic skin texture, natural fabric detail, warm beige and amber color palette, high-end editorial photography, 3:4 vertical composition, intimate cozy atmosphere. Avoid extra people, text overlays, distortions, unnatural anatomy, or excessive glamour retouching.

Create a polished anime-style digital illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a young woman"} standing barefoot in a graceful ballet pirouette-like pose inside a bright European apartment. She has {argument name="hair color" default="short black bob hair with wispy bangs"}, fair skin, delicate facial features, soft red lips, and a calm upward gaze toward the open window. She wears a sleeveless {argument name="outfit pattern" default="sage green and cream gingham wide-leg jumpsuit"} with a fitted bodice, square neckline, thin straps, a narrow belt with a small buckle, cropped flowing trousers, and a small gold pendant necklace. Her hands are gently clasped at her waist, one leg supports her on bare toes while the other knee is lifted and bent across her body; emphasize that she is barefoot, with no ballet shoes or footwear. The room has tall white French doors and open casement windows, pale gray-white walls, a light textured floor, and strong morning sunlight casting long angular shadows. Outside the window is a softly blurred city balcony and neighboring buildings under a clear blue sky. A sheer white curtain billows dramatically inward from the breeze on the left side, creating a flowing ribbon shape. Use refined linework, soft watercolor-like shading, subtle painterly texture, elegant proportions, natural anatomy, cinematic lighting, airy atmosphere, pastel colors, and a clean high-resolution vertical composition. Add a small artist signature reading {argument name="signature text" default="HALF_DONE"} in the bottom-right corner. Avoid extra people, avoid text other than the signature, avoid shoes, avoid distorted feet or hands.

Create a dramatic vertical anime fantasy illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a lone frost samurai"} standing in the center of a frozen battlefield at night, shown from a low-angle full-body perspective to make him look powerful and imposing. He is a pale young male warrior with {argument name="hair color" default="messy snow-white hair"}, sharp tired eyes, a calm stoic expression, and faint cold breath in the air. He wears an ornate black kimono-style battle robe with deep navy shadows, white outer fabric and wind-swept sleeves, layered samurai armor plates at the waist and thighs, tall strapped boots, gold chains, round gold clasps, tassels, and intricate metallic accessories. Count exactly one warrior and one drawn weapon: he grips a single katana with an ornate black-and-gold hilt, its blade glowing icy blue-white like frozen light and extending diagonally across the lower right foreground. The environment is a devastated ice battlefield with jagged blue ice spires, broken dark spears or banners protruding from the snow, scattered frozen debris, drifting snowflakes, and a luminous full moon or moonlit cloud mass in the upper right. Use a cold blue, black, white, and silver palette with small gold accents, intense rim lighting, sparkling frost particles, high contrast, cinematic composition, detailed linework, glossy fabric folds, crystalline highlights, and dynamic flowing cloth blown by wind. Mood: {argument name="mood" default="quiet breath before the next move, all warmth freezing into stillness"}. No text, no logo, no watermark, no extra characters.

Create a bright mixed-media anime illustration of two cheerful fox-eared hiking girls, {argument name="character name" default="Alma"}, walking side by side on a wooden boardwalk through a lush alpine wetland at {argument name="location" default="Chisenupuri mountain"}. Use a realistic outdoor landscape background with green marsh grasses, reflective water channels, dense forest, a rounded mountain in the distance, and a vivid blue sky with soft white clouds. The girls should be full-body anime characters composited naturally into the scene: both have golden-brown fox ears, short fluffy light-brown/blonde hair, amber eyes, happy open-mouth expressions, backpacks, hiking boots, and outdoor trekking clothes. The left girl wears an oversized dark {argument name="left jacket color" default="red plaid"} hooded jacket, black shorts, black hiking boots, and a backpack, walking casually with one hand near her backpack strap. The right girl wears a {argument name="right jacket color" default="beige"} hiking jacket, brown shorts over black leggings, purple socks, tan hiking boots, a backpack harness, and holds one black trekking pole while pointing upward with her other hand. Behind each girl is one large translucent iridescent bubble-shaped fox tail, for a total of exactly 2 bubble tails, shaped like soft rounded fox tails with pastel rainbow highlights and transparent glassy edges. Add exactly 12 floating soap bubbles of varied sizes around the scene: 6 on the left side of the image including one large cropped foreground bubble at the bottom-left, and 6 on the right side including one large bubble near the lower-right. Style the characters with clean high-quality anime line art, soft cel shading, detailed hair and clothing folds, while the scenery remains naturalistic and sunlit. Composition should be horizontal 4:3, eye-level, lively and whimsical, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.

Create a realistic vertical portrait photograph of a young adult woman sitting on a bed in a cozy sunlit bedroom. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long wavy chestnut brown hair"} swept over one shoulder, soft natural makeup, warm brown eyes, a gentle confident smile, and lightly flushed cheeks. She wears a fitted cream ribbed camisole with thin straps and matching cream drawstring lounge pants, plus delicate gold hoop earrings and a small round gold pendant necklace. Frame her from mid-thigh to head, seated slightly angled toward the camera with relaxed shoulders and direct eye contact. Use warm golden-hour window light from the left, casting soft architectural shadows on the pale wall and bedding; include a blurred bed, pillows, white trim, and a warm wooden bedside lamp or furniture in the background. Style it as an intimate lifestyle fashion portrait with shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, soft highlights, 85mm lens look, high-resolution editorial realism, balanced composition, no text, no watermark.

Create a polished modern moe anime illustration of a cheerful young woman taking a selfie on a sunny city cafe street. She has {argument name="hair color" default="soft chocolate brown"} hair styled into two high twin tails with loose flowing strands and black ribbon bows, large sparkling {argument name="eye color" default="pink violet"} eyes, flushed cheeks, and an open happy smile. Use a close wide-angle selfie perspective with her extended arm large in the foreground, camera slightly above chest height, making her face and upper body the focal point. Her outfit is a feminine summer casual look: a white frilled camisole with tiny black bow detail and vertical pintuck texture, a loose pale pink cardigan slipping off one shoulder, a pink plaid high-waisted skirt, a black belt with gold buckle, heart earrings, delicate necklace, and a small black crossbody bag with a gold chain. Set the scene on a bright tree-lined sidewalk outside a stylish cafe with storefront windows, warm interior lights, a pink awning, flower planters, a blackboard sign reading {argument name="cafe sign text" default="Cafe de Floral"}, street lamps, pedestrians softly blurred in the distance, and dappled sunlight across the pavement. Use glossy high-detail anime rendering, soft pastel colors, delicate linework, luminous skin shading, detailed hair highlights, shallow depth of field, bokeh, warm midday sunlight, and a cute light-novel cover aesthetic. Vertical portrait composition, no watermark, no extra captions, no distorted hands, preserve a clean attractive anime style.

Create a photorealistic full-body cosplay portrait of two characters posing together in a lavish European palace ballroom. On the left stands a large mascot-like man in an oversized white egg-shaped head with a smug sleepy face, tiny ears, a black curled forelock, and small black moustache dots, wearing a formal black tailcoat with white trim, white gloves, a white cravat with a red jewel, green lapels, a brown waistcoat, loose brown trousers, black boots, and a black sash; he holds both lapels with his gloved hands. On the right stands {argument name="character name" default="Celestine"}, a slender young blonde woman with very long pale-blonde hair and a red ribbon, wearing an elegant deep {argument name="dress color" default="crimson red"} Victorian ball gown with voluminous skirt, long sleeves, cream lace trim, lace bodice detailing, and a demure noblewoman expression; she leans gently against the mascot character and looks toward the camera. Set them on polished marble flooring at the base of a grand staircase inside an opulent Baroque palace with gilded walls, red velvet panels, ornate columns, arched tall windows, balcony railings, and a glowing crystal chandelier overhead. Use warm cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric textures, glossy floor reflections, low-angle composition, 3:4 vertical framing, and rich gold-and-red color grading. The image contains exactly two visible people: one oversized mascot gentleman and one aristocratic woman. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

Create a highly detailed cinematic fantasy anime illustration of a beautiful {argument name="dancer identity" default="Middle Eastern moon dancer"} in side profile at night, standing beside a calm oasis or palace waterfront under a huge glowing full moon. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="dark ash-brown hair"} swept by the wind, closed eyes, soft lips, and a serene expression as she raises both hands delicately toward the moon as if cradling or kissing its light. Dress her in an ornate {argument name="costume colors" default="deep crimson and sheer ivory"} dancer costume with gold embroidery, translucent veils streaming dramatically to the left, layered gold bracelets, chains, jeweled earrings, necklace, and an elaborate golden hair ornament with red gemstones and a large red rose in her hair. The scene should feel romantic, mystical, and luxurious: golden flower petals and sparkling dust swirl through the foreground and midground, with a few large blurred petals close to the camera for depth. In the background show a star-filled desert sky, faint Milky Way, silhouettes of palm trees and dark hills, warm palace lights reflected on rippling water, and the enormous detailed moon glowing behind her hands and face.
